sources.name: PSX Data Portal (dps.psx.com.pk)
sources.access: scrape (undocumented JSON/HTML endpoints) + manual; official bulk data licensing via marketdatarequest@psx.com.pk
sources.notes: The single best free primary source. Public, no login, data delayed ~5 min (powered by Capital Stake). Undocumented but stable JSON-ish endpoints widely scraped: /timeseries/int/{SYMBOL} (intraday), /timeseries/eod/{SYMBOL} (EOD history), /market-watch, /company/{SYMBOL}, /historical, /symbols, /sector-summary, /screener, /indices, /downloads. Several open-source wrappers exist (mtauha/psxdata, MuhammadAmir5670/psx-data-reader, ahad-raza24/PSX-MCP-Server). Light/no bot-wall on JSON endpoints; be polite with rate. Financials live on a separate financials portal. Update: real-time-ish during session; EOD after close.

sources.name: PSX main site (psx.com.pk)
sources.access: manual / scrape
sources.notes: Corporate/regulatory site rather than a data API. Good for index methodology, constituents, listing rules, notices. Time-series market data is better pulled from dps.psx.com.pk. No public API.

sources.name: SCSTrade / stocks.pk (scstrade.com)
data_types: fundamentals & ratios (EPS, PE, Book Value, ROE, ROA)
sources.access: scrape (ASP.NET .aspx pages + internal AJAX/JSON handlers); manual
sources.notes: Broker (SCS) research portal; one of the richest FREE fundamentals/ratios sources for PSX. Key pages: /stockscreening/SS_CompanySnapShot.aspx?symbol=XXX, SS_CompanySnapShotQF.aspx (quarterly financials), SS_CompanySnapShotYR.aspx (yearly ratios), SS_TechSnapShot.aspx (technicals), /research/RE_Reports.aspx. Legacy ASP.NET means __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION tokens on POSTs; some data loads via internal JSON web-methods you can hit directly. stocks.pk historically redirected/related to the same SCS ecosystem. No official API; scrape-friendly-ish but structure changes occasionally. Update: intraday for quotes, per-filing for fundamentals.

sources.name: Sarmaaya (sarmaaya.pk)
data_types: indices (KSE100 with PE, div yield, mcap, 52wk)
sources.access: scrape / manual; freemium with login for portfolio & premium
sources.notes: PSX-authorized data redistributor. Clean, structured pages (e.g. /indexes/KSE100, per-company pages) make it a good scrape target for fundamentals, payouts and fund data. Freemium: basic market data free; portfolio tracking, calculators and some research behind login/subscription. No documented public API. Reliable and well-maintained; update frequency intraday to daily.

sources.name: KSEStocks (ksestocks.com)
sources.access: scrape / manual
sources.notes: Long-running community/analytics site focused on corporate-action calendars (board meetings, book closures, dividend schedule) and daily quotations — useful complement to price sources. Content-heavy HTML; scrape by page. No API. Medium reliability; update daily/around events.

sources.name: Mettis Global (mettisglobal.news)
sources.access: scrape / manual; commercial Mettis terminal/data feed is paid
sources.notes: Primarily a financial NEWS + data-analytics house (Karachi). Free news site (mettisglobal.news) with /MarketData, /equity, /PSXRoundup sections; the real product is a paid professional terminal/data feed (MG Link) sold to institutions — pricing on request. Good for real-time news, results announcements and forex/rates commentary. No free public API.

sources.name: Business Recorder markets (brecorder.com/markets)
sources.access: scrape / manual
sources.notes: Leading financial daily; markets section carries quote tables, gold and currency rates plus news. WebFetch hit HTTP 403 (bot-wall / WAF) — needs a realistic User-Agent/headers or headless browser to scrape reliably. No API; primarily news + snapshot tables, not deep time-series.

sources.name: Profit by Pakistan Today (profit.pakistantoday.com.pk)
data_types: PSX market news/wraps (KSE100 levels, points moves)
sources.access: scrape / manual
sources.notes: Business magazine — NEWS not structured data. Good for daily PSX session wraps (open/high/close, points) and macro/policy context to enrich a dataset with event/sentiment tags. No numeric API; parse article text. Reliable editorially; daily updates.

sources.name: Investing.com — Pakistan / Karachi 100
sources.access: scrape (heavy anti-bot) / manual download
sources.notes: Has downloadable KSE100 historical data and equity quotes, but aggressive Cloudflare/anti-bot (JS challenges, 403s) makes scraping fragile — needs headless browser/undetected driver or their paid partners. No free official API (investing.com API is unofficial/deprecated). Coverage of individual PSX small-caps is patchy. Medium reliability for the index.

sources.name: Trading Economics — Pakistan (tradingeconomics.com/pakistan)
data_types: macro (GDP, inflation 9.2%, policy rate 11.5%, USD/PKR ~278, debt/GDP 83%, unemployment, current account, FX reserves)
sources.access: official API (paid) + scrape/manual for web pages
sources.notes: Broad macro + markets aggregator with a documented API (docs.tradingeconomics.com) but the free API tier is very limited (sample/select series only); full Pakistan coverage and KSE100 history need a paid subscription. Web pages scrapeable for spot values. Also hosts a clean /pakistan/rating page consolidating S&P/Moody's/Fitch. High reliability; update daily/on release.

sources.name: CEIC Data — Pakistan
data_types: deep macro (national accounts, BoP, monetary, fiscal, trade, inflation, FX)
sources.access: paid subscription (platform + API/Excel plugin); 10-day free flex trial
sources.notes: Premium macro/industry database (6.6M+ series, 200+ economies) with strong Pakistan depth sourced from SBP/PBS/ministries — cleaned and standardized. Not free: subscription required; 10-day no-card trial gives temporary access. Best when budget exists and you want normalized, ready-to-use macro series instead of scraping SBP/PBS yourself. High reliability.

sources.name: WSJ / MarketWatch / Bloomberg — Pakistan (KSE100)
sources.access: scrape (heavy paywall/anti-bot) / manual
sources.notes: Western terminals carry the KSE100 index (Bloomberg KSE100:IND; MarketWatch/WSJ quote pages) but individual PSX stock coverage is thin and most useful data sits behind paywalls + strong anti-bot. Not a practical bulk source for Pakistan; use only for cross-checking the headline index. Low practical value vs local sources.

sources.name: State Bank of Pakistan — EasyData (easydata.sbp.org.pk)
data_types: macro & monetary (policy/interest rates, monetary aggregates M2, FX reserves, exchange rate, external sector/BoP, debt, real sector)
18,000+ time series incl. mirrored PBS data
sources.access: API (new dataset-retrieval API) + web plot/CSV/Excel download; scrape
sources.notes: THE authoritative free macro source. Interactive Oracle APEX portal, no login, 18,000+ variables across ~90 datasets; recent upgrade added an API to retrieve full datasets plus related-series/most-viewed features. NOTE: base URL returned HTTP 403 to plain WebFetch (APEX session + WAF) — hit the specific f?p= APEX deep-links or the dataset API with proper session/headers, or a headless browser. Highest reliability for monetary/external data; update per SBP release schedule.

sources.name: State Bank of Pakistan — main site (sbp.org.pk)
sources.access: manual / scrape (mostly PDF)
sources.notes: Primary-source PDFs (e.g. Monthly Statistical Bulletin) and policy announcements. Use EasyData for machine-readable series; use the main site for narrative reports and the latest headline numbers. Free, high reliability, monthly/on-release updates. PDF parsing required for tables.

sources.name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (pbs.gov.pk)
sources.access: manual / scrape; interactive dashboards; PDF & flipbook downloads
sources.notes: Authoritative source for inflation (CPI/SPI), GDP and trade. Data mostly as PDF reports + interactive web dashboards (National Accounts, Census 2023, Trade Statistics); NO documented API (though much of it is mirrored into SBP EasyData in machine-readable form — prefer EasyData for series). Free, high reliability, monthly (CPI/SPI) to annual cadence.

sources.name: Finance Division — Pakistan Economic Survey (finance.gov.pk)
data_types: annual Pakistan Economic Survey (all macro sectors)
sources.access: manual download (HTML + PDF chapters)
sources.notes: Flagship annual Economic Survey (2025-26 published Jul 2026) with per-chapter PDFs + Highlights; also budget-in-brief and fiscal data. Great for annual authoritative fiscal/real-sector numbers and policy context. No API; scrape/parse HTML index + PDFs. Free, high reliability, mainly annual (survey/budget cycle).

sources.name: IMF — Pakistan country page & data portal
data_types: Article IV & EFF program staff reports (rich macro tables/projections)
sources.access: free API (IMF Data Portal / SDMX) + manual PDF download
sources.notes: Country page hosts Article IV / EFF reports (e.g. CR 24/310 & 24/311, 37-month EFF SDR 5.32bn) — excellent for validated macro + forward projections. IMF Data Portal (data.imf.org, new; legacy at legacydata.imf.org) offers free programmatic access (SDMX/JSON) to WEO, IFS, BOP etc. incl. Pakistan. High reliability; WEO twice-yearly, reports per review. Best free source for forecasts/projections.

sources.name: Sovereign ratings — S&P / Moody's / Fitch (Pakistan) + aggregators
sources.access: manual (agency press releases; free registration for full agency reports) + scrape aggregators
sources.notes: Current (2026): S&P B-/Stable (upgraded from CCC+, Jul 2025); Fitch B-/Stable (upgraded Apr 2025 from CCC+); Moody's Caa1/Positive (upgraded from Caa2). Agency sites (spglobal.com, moodys.com, fitchratings.com) need free login for full reports; ratings themselves are public via press releases. Easiest structured pull: aggregators tradingeconomics.com/pakistan/rating, countryeconomy.com/ratings/pakistan, theglobaleconomy.com/Pakistan/credit_rating. No API on free tier; update only on rating actions.

sources.name: EODHD (PSX.KAR) — third-party API aggregator
data_types: fundamentals (EPS, PE, PEG, EBITDA, dividends, splits)
sources.access: paid API (free tier limited to ~20 calls/day, delayed/EOD)
sources.notes: Commercial financial-data API that lists Pakistan (Karachi, suffix .KAR). JSON/CSV, developer-friendly — the main turnkey API if you want to avoid scraping. Coverage of PSX fundamentals is decent but not exhaustive vs local sources and can lag; paid subscription needed for full/real usage. Alternatives with thin PSX coverage: GuruFocus, Simply Wall St (analysis, not bulk API). Medium reliability for PK specifically.

sources.name: Open-source PSX scrapers / libraries
sources.access: open-source code (scrape dps.psx.com.pk under the hood); self-host
sources.notes: Not a data source per se but ready-made wrappers over dps.psx.com.pk: mtauha/psxdata (Python lib + FastAPI REST), MuhammadAmir5670/psx-data-reader (pip psx-data-reader, returns pandas DataFrames), AbdulSami455/PSX-Data-Api, ahad-raza24/PSX-MCP-Server. Saves reverse-engineering the portal endpoints. Reliability tracks the upstream portal; verify they still work as PSX HTML/JSON changes. Free/MIT-style.
